text.tspan: What the Netflix effect did to F1 drivers' personal brands

svg.text: FOLLOWERS VS. ENGAGEMENT ON INSTAGRAM · SAME STUDY, MAY 2024

text.tspan: Norris has less than a quarter of Hamilton's followers — but more than double his
engagement. Weak, non-significant correlation (r=-0.35, p=0.65, n=4).

svg.text: A DRIVER'S BRAND VS. F1'S OWN BRAND (INSTAGRAM)

text.tspan: By 2023, Hamilton already had 44% more followers than F1's official account. By 2024, his account
reached 37M — far surpassing the sport that made him famous.
